description: AIORI 2.0 Phase 2: three-year (2022-2024) flow-only preprocessing for the fixed 200 AIORI sensors
timestamps: reconstructed from file names (YYYY_pMM) and 288 five-minute slots per day; the raw arrays carry no timestamps
timezone_assumption: Pacific local wall-clock time (America/Los_Angeles), INFERRED from the 2023 spring-forward hour being missing; every day keeps all 288 stored slots and no DST hour is shifted or removed
channel_definitions: working convention from aiori/config.py; not confirmed by the publisher

conservative.description: Mask non-finite flow (all years) and every simultaneous flow=occupancy=speed=0 reading in 2022/2024

outage.description: Mask non-finite flow (all years) and only all-three-zero runs of at least 12 steps (1 hour) in 2022/2024; shorter all-zero bursts are kept as possibly valid low-volume readings
outage.rationale: An operating freeway detector reporting zero flow, zero occupancy and zero speed for an hour or more is consistent with an outage (the 2023 spring-forward gap is exactly 12 steps); 2023 never shows the all-zero pattern, so isolated bursts are uncertain and kept
